title: Pepper's ghost premieres at the Royal Polytechnic
description: John Henry Pepper stages Henry Dircks's angled-glass ghost illusion in London; the pair patent it in 1863.

title: Enchanted Tiki Room opens at Disneyland
description: First Audio-Animatronics show: roughly 150 birds, flowers and tikis driven from recorded tape.

title: The Haunted Mansion opens at Disneyland
description: Its ballroom becomes the most famous Pepper's ghost scene, and filmed faces projected onto busts foreshadow projection mapping.

title: USITT publishes DMX512
description: A single serial standard for lighting control replaces proprietary dimmer protocols; later ANSI E1.11.

title: Fantasmic! opens at Disneyland
description: Animation projected onto three mist screens, with fire and pyrotechnics, sets the template for water-screen spectaculars.

title: World of Color opens at Disney California Adventure
description: More than 1,200 fountains and a 380-foot combined mist screen.

title: The Hatbox Ghost returns with a projected face
description: The illusion that failed in 1969 under ambient light is rebuilt using projection mapping on the figure.

title: 1,218 drones fly at the Pyeongchang Winter Olympics opening
description: Intel Shooting Star drones set a world record for simultaneous drones, moving drone shows into the mainstream.
